entries.title: Psalms 93:1
segments: ¶Jehovah reigneth, he hath clothed himself with majesty: Jehovah hath clothed himself, he hath girded himself with strength; yea, the world is established, it shall not be moved.

entries.title: Psalms 93:2
segments: Thy throne is established of old; thou art from eternity.

entries.title: Psalms 93:3
segments: The floods lifted up, O Jehovah, the floods lifted up their voice; the floods lifted up their roaring waves.

entries.title: Psalms 93:4
segments: Jehovah on high is mightier than the voices of many waters, than the mighty breakers of the sea.

entries.title: Psalms 93:5
segments: Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thy house, O Jehovah, for ever.
